Optional Feature Disclosure

Accessibility Service Disclosure (Optional)

ScreenSync works standalone using standard Android Usage Access for daily screen time. If you optionally enable the ScreenSync Accessibility Service, ScreenSync observes foreground app package transitions (TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED) to enforce your configured App Timers, Focus Mode distraction guards, and Bedtime Wind-Down rules, and observes vertical scroll gestures (TYPE_VIEW_SCROLLED) and structural player surface geometry inside supported short-form video feeds (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook Reels, Messenger & WhatsApp Stories, Snapchat Spotlight, Reddit Watch, X Video, and supported mobile browsers) to update your daily Reel counter and floating pill.

  • Data Privacy: ScreenSync immediately aborts inspection on any password field or banking/password-manager app, hashes local deduplication tokens in memory, and never stores or transmits raw captions, passwords, private messages, chat text, or keystrokes.
  • No Third-Party Sharing: Accessibility event signals are processed locally on your device and are never sold, shared, or used for advertising.
  • 100% Optional & Revocable: You can decline or turn off this service at any time in ScreenSync or Android Settings, and ScreenSync's core screen-time tracking will continue to work normally.

Cross-Device Guide

How ScreenSync works across your devices

Help & Support

1. Getting Started with ScreenSync

ScreenSync organizes your digital wellness into four main tabs: Overview (daily summary and reel insights), Screen Time (Day, Week, Month, and Year analytics plus Unlocks), Focus (focus timer, streaks, and daily goals), and Account (profile, connected devices, permissions, and theme settings).

2. Creating an Account & Signing In

Open Create New Account on the login screen, enter your name, email address, and a password meeting all 5 live requirements (8–32 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol), then verify the 6-digit OTP code delivered to your email. Use your verified email and password to sign in on any supported device.

3. Adding an Account After Logging Out

When no account is logged in, the Account section displays a single Add Account entry. Tap Add Account at any time to open the login screen and sign in or register a new account.

4. Registering & Connecting Supported Devices

When you sign in, ScreenSync automatically detects and registers your current device installation under your account (supporting Android, iOS/iPadOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS/Chromebook, and the Desktop Browser Extension). Re-signing in on the same device re-verifies the existing installation without creating duplicates.

5. How Cross-Device Synchronization Works

Usage sessions, reel events, and goal updates synchronize automatically in the background while online. If a device goes offline, events are stored in the local offline queue with deduplication and flushed automatically as soon as connectivity returns.

6. How Screen Time & App Usage Are Collected

ScreenSync records active foreground app sessions, app launches (Times Opened), notification counts, and device Unlocks. Background or screen-off intervals are excluded so idle time never inflates your screen time.

7. How Reel, Short-Video & Story Tracking Works

Short-form tracking uses a two-stage validation engine (300ms scroll-settle debounce plus 1,200ms continuous dwell) across Instagram Reels & Stories, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Facebook/FB Lite Reels & Stories, Messenger Stories, WhatsApp Status, and Snapchat Spotlight/Stories. Replaying the same video adds watch time without inflating your reel count, and opening comment or share sheets pauses the timer.

8. How Account-Wide Totals Are Calculated Across Devices

When All Devices is selected, ScreenSync computes the mathematical interval union of your foreground sessions across devices. If you use a phone and a laptop at the same time for 30 minutes, the overlapping 30 minutes is counted once toward elapsed wall-clock screen time rather than doubled.

9. Configuring Operating System Permissions

In Account → Notification Settings → OS Permissions & Presentation, tap Guided Setup or Open Settings to grant Usage Access, Navigation Detection, Display Over Other Apps / Live Activities, and System Notifications in your device's native settings.

10. Screen Time Goal & Reel Watch Time Goal Across Devices

Set independent daily Screen Time and Reel Watch Time goals using the scrollable hour and minute wheels in Overview, Screen time, or Focus. Goal settings sync to your account and trigger system-level goal-reached alerts across online connected devices once per daily period.

11. Resolving Common Synchronization or Permission Problems

If usage does not update across devices, verify that both devices are signed in to the same email account, check Cross-Device Real-Time Sync in Account to confirm Network Mode is Online, and re-verify any skipped OS permissions in Guided Setup.

12. Logging Out Safely Without Deleting Data

Selecting Logout in the Account section immediately ends your active session, revokes the session token, and clears your personal identity from the screen while keeping all historical screen time, reel events, focus sessions, and goals safely stored in your account database.

13. Platform-Specific Limitations & Requirements

Android supports full native UsageStatsManager, AccessibilityService, and system overlay pills when permissions are granted. iOS/iPadOS enforces app sandboxing and uses FamilyControls/DeviceActivity and ActivityKit Dynamic Island Live Activities rather than arbitrary cross-app overlays. Windows, macOS, Linux (X11/Wayland/MPRIS via screensync_linux_companion.py), and ChromeOS track foreground windows/tabs and use the Desktop Browser Extension (or ChromeOS ARC++ Android bridge) for third-party web short-form video sessions. In standalone web browsers without native OS bridges, tracking operates on in-app and synced account data, and per-app timers issue warning alerts rather than OS-level app blocking.

14. Per-Platform Step-by-Step Setup Guide

Actionable onboarding steps for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and the Desktop Browser Extension

Android (Phone & Tablet)
  1. Install io.screensync.wellness and sign in with your verified email and 6-digit OTP.
  2. Open Account → Notification Settings → Guided Setup to grant Usage Access, Navigation Detection (Accessibility), Display Over Other Apps, and Notifications (plus OEM AutoStart on Xiaomi HyperOS, Samsung, Vivo, OPPO/Realme/OnePlus, or Honor/Huawei).
  3. Open FAQ & Verification Suite and confirm Device Permissions and Activity Tracking report active.
iOS & iPadOS (iPhone & iPad)
  1. Install ScreenSync on iOS/iPadOS and sign in with your verified ScreenSync account.
  2. Use Guided Setup to authorize Screen Time (FamilyControls / DeviceActivity), Live Activities (ActivityKit) for Dynamic Island & Lock Screen widgets, and Notifications.
  3. Open Verification Suite to confirm real-time sync and Lock Screen widget readiness.
Windows (Desktop Companion)
  1. Sign in to ScreenSync and generate a 6-character pairing code in Account → Connected Devices.
  2. Launch platforms/windows/ScreenSyncWindowsCompanion.csproj (listening on http://127.0.0.1:19540/api/companion/status and /api/companion/history) for Win32/UWP foreground window and WASAPI audio tracking.
  3. Check Tracker Heartbeats in the Verification Suite to verify fresh Windows ticks.
macOS (Desktop Companion)
  1. Sign in to ScreenSync on your Mac and pair your installation under Connected Devices.
  2. Run platforms/macos/Sources/main.swift (serving http://127.0.0.1:19540/api/companion/status) and grant macOS Accessibility & Screen Recording window-title permissions in System Settings.
  3. Verify the macOS companion heartbeat status in the Verification Suite.
Linux (X11 / Wayland / Flathub & Snap)
  1. Sign in to ScreenSync and start the Linux companion daemon via python3 platforms/linux/screensync_linux_companion.py on 127.0.0.1:19540 (or install from platforms/linux/flathub or platforms/linux/snap).
  2. Ensure X11 (xprintidle / xdotool), Wayland (swaymsg / hyprctl / loginctl IdleHint), and MPRIS media players are accessible.
  3. Open Verification Suite to confirm the Linux companion heartbeat is Active / Fresh.
Desktop Browser Extension (Manifest V3)
  1. Open chrome://extensions or edge://extensions, enable Developer mode, click Load unpacked, and select platforms/browser-extension/.
  2. Keep ScreenSync open while signed in so content_bridge.js and background_collector.js complete the extension handshake.
  3. Open YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, or Facebook Reels and verify Tracker Heartbeats & Reel FSM in the Verification Suite.
